nodes.acceptance: Editing #prop-label changes selected label exactly once and survives reload.
#prop-w updates canonical width with valid numeric bounds and persists.
#prop-h updates canonical height with valid numeric bounds and persists.
#file-input accepts supported multiple files, records metadata and never executes imported script.
#team-mode cycles single/race/quorum/sequence and persists exact selected mode.

nodes.task: Apply proposed delta through delta preview
nodes.acceptance: Clicking #delta-preview with proposed delta applies operations exactly once and is undoable.
#media-upload records image/audio/video/3D metadata without leaking file contents or tokens.
landing/dashboard/saas/portfolio/blank create editable page nodes with correct template record.
background/accent/radius controls update visible CSS and persisted config with reload readback.
planner/designer/coder/reviewer roles persist; secret_ref stays reference-only; invalid endpoint gets deterministic feedback.
MCP_HTTP/HTTP/WEBSOCKET/API save and probe paths are distinguishable and fail closed on invalid URL.
image/video/audio/3d produce correctly typed queued or blocked jobs.
DOWNLOAD/GITHUB/HUGGINGFACE/VERCEL/MCP/SHARE/CUSTOM_HTTP create typed plans; no inline secrets.

nodes.task: Drag/drop matrix for all 10 component kinds
nodes.acceptance: window/button/selector/segment/panel/page/image/video/audio/model3d drop once at bounded coordinates and remain editable.
resize changes canonical w/h, respects minimums/snap and is undoable; no touch-drag collision.
duplicate/delete keyboard+pointer actions mutate canonical state exactly once and persist.
If still ZIP_ONLY use existing extraction motor, record blob/count/license, then thin diagram render adapter + browser microtest.
Extract only if needed; convert useful WCAG/ARIA rules into Factory tests, not runtime dependency.
Extract only if needed; adapt screenshot comparison workflow into bounded QA with artifacts, not runtime code.
Use local source; if ZIP_ONLY materialize with existing motor; extract only inspector/style-edit patterns needed by current Factory; no Onlook monolith.

lane_dependency: Within each lane, only first unclaimed node is eligible; next requires previous PASS_RELEASED or GAP_RESOLVABLE report.
release_rule: PASS_RELEASED or GAP_RESOLVABLE with paths/blob SHA/commit/test/run/job/artifact/readback. Producer never promotes candidate.
